experiments.name: GTM Model6 | US plume identification
experiments.description: Sentinel-only plume detection supervised by EMIT positive outlines and reviewed US plume/no-plume examples. Actual held-location outputs are in the plume experiment entries.
experiments.notes: The new models produce some localized plumes but fail aggregate detection checks. EMIT-only reconstruction is a separate historical diagnostic.

experiments.name: ERSRR v5.1 · three-seed temporal model
experiments.description: MethaneS2CM location-held-out test: 20,789 L2A scenes across 816 locations.
experiments.notes: Crop classification signal, poor plume localization. Scene AP is not segmentation accuracy. Frozen scene cutoff 0.7335791607366197 and separate pixel cutoff 0.40. A spatially constant crop baseline matches 99.8289% of the full-cache masks; pixel precision is 19.84%. All three checkpoint hashes were verified locally and CPU replay reproduced every thresholded pixel in these eight examples. H5 point coordinates do not establish geographic footprints. L1C-trained zero-shot comparators do not isolate architecture effects on this L2A benchmark.

experiments.name: Compact ResUNet
experiments.notes: Two legacy validation-folder scenes in Texas. Fresh Keras/Torch inference, not a rerun of a frozen benchmark. Reference acquisition dates and product-level metadata are unverified; geographic holdout independence has not been established. These examples cannot validate US-wide performance.

experiments.name: Spatial successor
